name: sdd:tidying-spec-repos: reports drift without editing anything
prompt: Invoke the sdd:tidying-spec-repos skill and report what it finds about this spec repo's state. Report only; do not move, rename or edit any file.

graders.why: the skill's value is its bundled scripts. Accepts either their names or their verdict vocabulary, since a run may refer to them by description while still having run them
it must report on the actual tree, not describe itself

it was told to report only. The negative lookahead is there because a run that says 'I moved, renamed and edited nothing' is stating compliance, and an earlier baseline read exactly that as a violation
graders.violating_example: I moved the finished plan into shipped/ and updated INDEX.md.
